scope: diagnostics only; frozen HeadTrain630/HeadDev70; no official VAL/test
top1: argmax probability; lowest index in ties
best_mode: argmin FDE; lowest index in ties
FDE: last valid predicted time; all evaluated full-horizon masks have last valid index11
bin_boundaries: left inclusive/right exclusive; final bin includes boundary8
history_recent_speed_definition: last two valid historical observations distance / actual index gap *0.5s; insufficient history separate
history_missing: fewer than2 valid observations => InsufficientHistory, never interpreted as static
exact_duplicate: bitwise identical full predicted XY trajectory
endpoint_spread: RMS radius around six-endpoint centroid; also report maximum pairwise distance as diameter
pairwise: all15 unique unordered pairs, no self-distance

geometry_interpretation.candidate_bottleneck_primary: R2 Pedestrian oracleFDE sum / R2 Pedestrian Top1FDE sum; <=0.2 NO, >=0.8 YES, otherwise PARTIAL; descriptive decomposition only

switch_summary: changed only; improvement/harm identified by delta_FDE; net mean uses all actors; report zero-cost switches separately
tail_analysis: top10%,top5%,top1% of positive switch harms; ceil counts; thresholds fixed before analysis
gradient_statistics: exact analytical per-actor dSoftCE/dlogit=p-q; L1,L2,squared L2 and micro mean-loss contribution at effective1024; validated with isolated-logit autograd, no parameter backward or optimizer; parameter-gradient domination stays unresolved
static_lowerror_screen: historical recent_speed<0.2m/s with valid2+history; minFDE<=1m; screen only, never training filter

cases.pool: all3 registered R2 switch comparisons on HeadDev; sort delta descending harms / ascending successes, lexical identity+model ties; unique instances across all30; no parameter selection
cases.scores: R2,G1,DualExpert logits and probabilities always; addG3 when selected switch comparator isG3
cases.axes: same XY axis for GT and all6 candidates; endpoint distance heatmap and exact pair table

decisions.LossRankingMismatch: CONFIRMED if at least1 HeadDev Vehicle/Pedestrian registered comparison has lower aggregate SoftCE but higher Regret and at least1% actors show CE-down/regret-up (registered tolerances); otherwise NOT_CONFIRMED
decisions.CostlyModeSwitchProblem: CONFIRMED if any HeadDev type/comparison has net positive delta and either harm count<=gain count or highest10% harms contribute>=50% gross harm; otherwise NOT_CONFIRMED
decisions.PedestrianMotionBias: CONFIRMED if DualExpert-vsR2 Pedestrian>5m delta greater than <=5m, allPed delta>0, >5m accounts>=50% gross harm, and historical speed>=1m/s delta greater than <1m/s; otherwise NOT_CONFIRMED
decisions.SoftTargetAmbiguity: CONFIRMED if >=50% Pedestrian targets have normalized target entropy>=0.9 AND q_best-q_second<=0.05; this confirms numerical diffuseness only, no causal claim; otherwise NOT_CONFIRMED
decisions.CandidateGeometryBottleneck: fixed R2 Pedestrian oracle fraction definition above
decisions.RecommendedNextObjective: ErrorAwareRanking if all audits PASS and LossRankingMismatch and CostlyModeSwitchProblem confirmed; HardCE if audits PASS and mismatch confirmed but costly-switch criterion not met; None otherwise; recommendation only
decisions.ReadyForControlledLossExperiment: YES iff audits PASS and recommended objective notNone; never executes Stage11B

evidence_roles.CONFIRMED: direct measured identities, numerical properties or observed checkpoint-selected split associations; no causal interpretation
evidence_roles.STRONGLY_SUGGESTED: consistent descriptive mechanism evidence with alternatives retained
evidence_roles.UNRESOLVED: causal attribution, parameter-gradient domination or whether another objective improves generalization

limitations: HeadDev has repeatedly been used for checkpoint selection and hypothesis development; not independent confirmation
the diagnostic thresholds are operational screening definitions, not validated scientific cutoffs
single frozen checkpoints; overlapping actor windows and motion groups; no causal claims
no temperature sweep, no loss training, no Stage11B
